justification: Achane's on IR, that's not a projection, that's a medical document, so he's out of the family business this week whether the sheet likes his upside or not — Javonte Williams steps into RB1, and that's not a downgrade in my book, a back who runs angry is a back who runs angry whether he's starting or waiting his turn. Breece Hall's Doubtful, and I don't gamble a flex spot on a guy who might not even suit up, so Harold Fannin gets the nod against a Pittsburgh front that's there for the taking today — he earns it, doesn't inherit it. Pittman's locked in at WR2 for the early kick against Cleveland, Boutte, LaPorta, Murray, Bates, and the Seattle D ride as-is, they haven't done anything to lose their chair. To the people reading tea leaves about this family stopping losing — we don't lose on purpose and we don't panic either, we just stopped carrying dead weight into Sunday, and that's the only threat anybody needs to hear about.
